description.narrative: Himachal Pradesh, located in northern India along the lower Himalayas, has a population of 6.8 million. Despite constraints such as its hilly terrain, poor connectivity, and predominantly rural population (90%), the state's economic, poverty, education, and health indicators have improved significantly since 2000 owing to the efforts of the Government of Himachal Pradesh (GOHP) to improve infrastructure and delivery of basic public services. While the government has successfully increased school and college enrollments over the past decade, it now faces the "second-generation" challenge of providing relevant and good quality technical and vocational education and training (TVET) opportunities to its youth to prepare them for the changing needs of the labor market. The project will assist GOHP in reforming and modernizing its TVET institutions and programs to boost the employability of Himachal Pradesh's youth and improve their employment prospects.

description.narrative: Improved employment and livelihood opportunities for the youth of Himachal Pradesh

Of those who are successfully certified, at least 50% should get wage employment within 6 months of completing training, with 40% of the remaining being gainfully self-employed (wage employment target for women: 30%) Progress/Status: Partially achieved.
As of 15th December, 2025, 35.15% (19752) got wage employment against the target of 50%.
23.00% (2532) of trainees are successfully gained the self-employment, against the target of 40%.
57.78% (11413) women are successfully gained the wage employment against the target of 30%. (Target Achieved) Data Source: Surveys undertaken by HPKVN Actual value:

a. At least 80% of all trainees who complete the training courses under the project are successfully certified (2016 baseline: 0; target: at least 70% of women trainees and people with disabilities who complete the training courses are successfully certified) Progress/Status: As of 15th December, 2025, 82.93% (55054) of trainees are successfully certified, against the target of 80%.
83.17% (23996) of women trainees are successfully certified, against the target of 70%.
85.42% (410) of People with Disabilities are successfully certified, against the target of 70%.
All the DMF targets has achieved. Data Source: MIS project reports prepared by HPKVN and implementing agencies

Output: Access to quality training institutes improved Indicator: Five city livelihood centers made operational to provide a package of training-cum-business development support to urban youth (2016 baseline: 0) Progress/Status: Out of total Six (6) CLCs, all the 6 CLCs have been completed and are operationalizing by the Department of Technical Education, Ministry of Textile and Weaver and Department of Urban Development (UD) i.e. CLC Sundernagar, CLC Shamshi, CLC Nahan, CLC Sidhbari, CLC Bilaspur and CLC Jubbal.
1. CLC Sundernagar - The site of CLC Sunder Nagar handed over to Department of Technical Education on 2nd April, 2022. The institute is dedicated for training Persons with Disabilities (PwD) students. In this institute, two trades of Electrician and Fitter are running under the ITI training component, total 160 students (16 female) have been benefited.
2. CLC Shamshi - The site has been handed over to Ministry of Textile and Weaver on 8th April, 2022. Ministry of Textile and Weaver Service Centre, Kullu has been established in the said building. A total of 500 trainees has been trained under Samarth/National Handloom Development Programme scheme with duration of 45 Days and Short Term & Obs. Training with duration of 4 Months.
3. CLC Sidhbari - This site has been handed over to Department of Urban Development on 10th August, 2023. Site is operationalized and 295 Self Help Group members have been trained in Capacity building cum Entrepreneurship Development Program (EDP) Trainings.
4. CLC Nahan- This site has been handed over to Department of Urban Development on 19th September 2022, Site is operationalized and 280 Self Help Group members has been trained in Capacity building cum Entrepreneurship Development Program (EDP) Trainings.
5. CLC Bilaspur - This site has been handed over to Department of Urban Development on 21st March 2025, currently 35 Self Help Group (SHGs) has been trained on Capacity building cum Entrepreneurship Development Program (EDP).
6. CLC Jubbal - The site of CLC Jubbal has been handed over to Department of Technical Education on 13th November, 2025. The institute is dedicated for training of Industrial Training Institution students.
HPSDP MIS is capturing the training numbers for CLCs. Data Source: Annual report of HPKVN (with inputs from relevant departments)

Output: Access to quality training institutes improved Indicator: Seven rural livelihood centers made operational to provide a package of training-cum-business development support to rural youth (2016 baseline: 0) Progress/Status: Out of seven (7) RLCs, construction work of five (6) RLCs have been completed and five (5) RLC has been handed over to the Department of Rural. Out of which three (3) RLCs have been Operationalized and (1) RLC is at handing over stage and one (1) RLC is at construction stage. Status of Operationalization of RLCs as below:
1. RLC Pragatinagar - RLC has been handed over to Department of Rural Development on 19th June, 2203. The trainings are being conducting for 30 Village Organization (VO) of 3 blocks which were trained under the application of LoKOS. This application will be used for the data capturing of self-help groups (SHG), Village Organizations (VO) and Cluster Level Federation (CLF). - In RLC Pragitinagar, packaging cum manufacturing unit and community managed training center has been setup by District level federation of district Shimla. Under the unit premium SHG products are produced like Apple Chips, Honey, Turmeric powder, red rice, ginger powder, Pahadi rajma, apricot oil and kodo flour. 30 members of SHG group are working in this unit. As of now INR 25 lakh ($30,000) income has generated during last 1 year. - under this unit, trainings are being conducted for Self Help Group members on LOKO's application, Lakhpati Didi Training, Non-Farm- Entrepreneurship Development Programme (EDP), training on Internal Community Recourse Person (I-CRP) Institution Building and Capacity Building (IBCB), Audit training on Institution Building and Capacity Building (IBCB) and SHG Training on Health Nutrition Gender (HNG), total 370 women participated 2. RLC Sadyana - RLC has been handed over to Department of Rural Development on 27th February, 2021. Training on Entrepreneurship Development Programme (EDP) has been initiated and 50 Self Help Group (SHGs) members participated. 3. RLC Chopal- The site has been handed over to Department of Rural Development on 1st August, 2024. In a recent communication received from the Department of Rural Development, the Department has expressed its inability to operationalize the site of RLC Chopal. The matter is being taken up for further directions. 4. RLC Bangana: RLC has been handed over to Department of Rural Development on 21st October, 2024. Total 130 members attended trainings on VPRP (Village Poverty Reduction Plan) training under the Deendayal Antyodaya Yojana-National Rural Livelihoods Mission (DAY-NRLM), WDC-PMKSY (Watershed Development Component of Pradhan Mantri Krishi Sinchayee Yojana) training and Cluster Level Federation Vision Building trainings. 5. RLC Nagrota Bagwan: The site has been handed over to Department of Rural Development on 10th April, 2025; A total of 22 Self-Help Group (SHG) members are being trained in candle making at the newly established center to promote self-employment and enhance livelihood skills of the rural women 6. RLC Seraj: Construction work of site has 100% completed, (Academic block 100% and Hostel Block 100%)), site will be handed over by December, 2025. 7. RLC Nalagarh: at under construction stage, overall, 62.33% of work has completed (Academic block 70.21% and Hostel Block 57.07%), site will be completed by March, 2026.
